alt.T01_hero_office_hide: Two hazmat-suited players hide behind a yellow wall while a dark entity with glowing eyes stands in the Level 1 corridor.
alt.T02_hero_six_levels: Six slices show the six levels: yellow office, poolrooms, party rooms, neon cinema, colour void and soft-play playground.
alt.G03_level2_the_stepwell: Two hazmat-suited players walk down zig-zag stairs in a vast sunlit stepwell above a green pool in Level 2.
alt.G05_level3_under_the_table: Two hazmat-suited players hide under a folding table as the balloon-headed Mall Manager walks past in Level 3.
alt.G08_level4_the_usher: A hazmat-suited player's torch beam freezes the Usher in a dark cinema aisle in Level 4.
alt.G09_level5_over_the_void: A hazmat-suited player jumps between narrow blue ledges over a black drop in Level 5.
alt.G11_level6_it_is_counting: Two hazmat-suited players hide behind netting above the court where a doll counts at a red post in Level 6.
alt.G02_level1_pull_the_fuse: A hazmat-suited player pulls a fuse from a wall relay while a teammate watches the Level 1 corridor.
alt.G04_level2_a_thousand_doors: Two hazmat-suited players stand in a drained pool beneath ten floors of identical yellow doors in Level 2.
alt.G12_level6_the_way_out: Two hazmat-suited players tumble out of a slide into a green padded room and run for the exit door in Level 6.

name.description_before:
⚠️ FLASHING LIGHTS • LOUD NOISES • SUDDEN CHASES

📡 ZYNTRA intercepted a signal from a place that doesn't exist.
Command Center sent your team to trace it.

Then the signal started using your names.

The halls remember every sound. The lights lead deeper. Something on the other side is waiting for you to answer.

👁️ Stay together. Stay quiet. Don't trust the static.
🤝 1–6 PLAYER CO-OP HORROR
📱 PC + MOBILE
🎧 HEADPHONES RECOMMENDED

THE TRANSMISSION IS STILL LIVE.
Will you follow it?
